title: every PROVED ticket names its owner, each read before filled
intention: Every PROVED ticket names its owning_intention, and each of the 100 blank ones is read before its owner is filled.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: 100 of 813 PROVED tickets under CairnCommons/tickets/ carry a blank owning_intention (3ca32dd07e86 and 94e1cce8941e among them). intention_fidelity cannot pair a charter with a ticket that names no owner, so the charters those tickets proved read as never proved. 94e1's read showed the owner cannot be taken from the title: it names feedback but settled a decision record.
traces_to: Law 6 (everything has exactly one owner) and Law 3 (nothing is known until measured).
how: For each blank PROVED ticket, read its intention, how, falsifier, decisions writes_to and bounds.in, and the git log of what its build wrote. Then name the charter whose claim it proved and write it through cairn artifact write --verb cast with a why naming what was read, one ticket per write, ensure_ascii=True. A ticket whose read finds no charter owner gets a question against this ticket (cairn question open --ticket 39f238fe4767), never a guess. The proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_proved_ticket_names_its_owner.py reads the live commons and reds any PROVED ticket with a blank owning_intention, or one that does not resolve to a charter.

out: the 44 PROVED tickets whose non-blank owner does not resolve (a separate defect, recorded in measured)

measured.saw: 813 PROVED tickets; 100 with blank owning_intention (first five: 004f68fe1038, 05a287de75de, 06cfbed24cd9, 0a98b3fadc80, 0cde908b8fbe); 44 more whose owner does not resolve by a naive path check
measured.how: read_ticket over CairnCommons/tickets/*.json on main, filtered on [PROVED] in workflow_and_state

measured.saw: 94e1cce8941e names feedback in its title but settled decisions/2026-08-21-feedback-is-probes-two-consumer-kinds, so a title-derived owner would be wrong

outcomes.claim: over the live commons, no PROVED ticket's owning_intention is blank
each owner filled by this ticket resolves to an intention+why.json (or a commons intention) on disk
each fill's artifact-journal line carries a why naming what was read; a why that cites only the title is red

outcomes.text: the fills, one cairn artifact write per ticket under CairnCommons/tickets/, each read first; a ticket with no charter owner becomes a question bound here.
the proof reads the live commons with one tooth per clause.
